metadata.description: Skills for AI coding agents, in six plugins: design, motion, studio, engineering, experience architecture and working style. Every command runs only when you call it, unless you choose at install to let the /design, /engineer or /database router start on its own.

plugins.name: design-kit
plugins.description: A design library for AI coding agents: a /design router that picks the right skill or recipe, plus vetted skills for typography, color, motion, UX writing, usability, landing copy, native iOS and more.

plugins.name: motion-kit
plugins.description: One command, /motion, for interface motion on the web, in React, SwiftUI and React Native: set up a motion system, storyboard a sequence, build an animation, review or fix existing motion. It measures before it judges, with a code inventory and frame-by-frame captures from a real browser. Runs only when you call it.

plugins.name: studio-kit
plugins.description: One command, /studio, that opens a live design studio on your computer: see finished looks and every option drawn for real, for a button, a colour palette or typography, in one workspace. Compare, fine-tune, undo, ask the agent for more, then send a proposal to chat. Nothing in your application changes until you approve it. Runs only when you call it.

plugins.name: engineering-kit
plugins.description: Engineering skills for AI coding agents. /engineer understands, diagnoses and fixes difficult codebases with evidence: what a change would reach, what the Git history shows, and before-and-after runs in throwaway copies. /database investigates PostgreSQL read-only with bounded queries and reconciles disputed figures to an exact bridge. Also vetted, pinned skills for bug diagnosis, test-first work, architecture scans, plan interviews, retros, primary-source research and setup wizards. Every command runs only when you call it, unless you choose at install to let /engineer and /database start on their own.

plugins.name: experience-architecture
plugins.description: Find out why a web app's navigation, pages, links or Back button feel wrong, decide whether its structure should change, and prove it in a real browser. Diagnose, Rethink and Verify over a zero-dependency toolkit for route maps, browser journeys, prototypes and URL migrations, plus Walkthrough (preview), which learns the product by using it, says what it should become and can carry the improvement through. Strongest on React and Next.js.

plugins.name: working-style
plugins.description: Four commands for working with an agent: /ceo explains in plain English, /recommend makes the call, /harsh-review gives direct critique with bounded fixes, /viewport-proof judges a screen across viewports with a proof sheet. Each runs only when you call it.
